Putting two of the greatest goalscorers in football history into a backline would leave his goalkeeper entirely unprotected. In contrast, Josh has a much more balanced, functional team structure. He features actual defensive presence with Marc Cucurella, elite midfield control with Rodri, and the explosive attacking threat of Lamine Yamal upfront. Because Josh’s team is built with players in their actual positions, they would easily dominate and win the match.
